Limitation_or_Note: The model uses national aggregated weather and cannot represent every farm's microclimate.
Yield can also depend on soil, fertilizer, irrigation, pests, disease, seed variety and farm practice.
Prices can change because of demand, transport costs, imports, inflation, festivals and unexpected events. Final test price R2 = -0.2449; this weakness must be stated in the report.
The final model uses the common reliable period 2012-2023.
Predictions support planning and should not replace farmer experience or agricultural advice.
